series.name: ET Series / ET Plus+ named messages (PV Master era)
series.notes: ET / ET Plus+ is the high-voltage battery hybrid line (40/50kW three-phase on the Pakistan product page). It has its own named-message table which is a superset of the ES table: it adds 'Utility Phase Failure' (unique to the three-phase ET) and 'PV/BAT Overvoltage' (covers battery overvoltage, not just PV). The ET Plus+ is a line GoodWe markets in Pakistan. Later ET/ET PLUS+/BT firmware uses the EMEA app codes in SERIES 5 - do not merge the two.

meaning.en: The inverter detected that the L2 and L3 phase angles are reversed, so it refuses to connect to the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne dekha ke L2 aur L3 ke phase angles ultay hain, is liye grid se connect nahi hota.

causes.en: L2 and L3 on-grid cables connected in reverse order.
causes.ur: On-grid ke L2 aur L3 cables ulat order mein lage hain.

causes.en: Phase angle detection error in the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter mein phase angle detection error.

solutions.en: Isolate AC fully and confirm dead before touching the phase cables.
solutions.ur: AC poori tarah isolate karke phase cables chhoone se pehle dead hona confirm karein.

solutions.en: Swap L2 and L3 at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par L2 aur L3 ko aik doosre se badal dein.

solutions.en: Re-check terminal tightness and phase sequence, then re-energise.
solutions.ur: Terminals ki tightening aur phase sequence dobara check karke dobara on karein.

notes.en: On EMEA firmware the same symptom appears as app codes 14ETU or 27ETU (Phase order / Phase angle failure).
notes.ur: EMEA firmware par yehi symptom app codes 14ETU ya 27ETU (Phase order / Phase angle failure) ke roop mein aata hai.

source.title: GW ET Series | ET Plus Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.1, section 4.1 Error Messages

title.ur: PV/BAT Overvoltage - PV ya battery voltage zyada

meaning.en: Either the PV string open-circuit voltage or the battery pack voltage is above the inverter's maximum input, so the unit stops.
meaning.ur: Ya PV string ka open-circuit voltage ya battery pack ka voltage inverter ke maximum input se upar hai, is liye unit ruk jata hai.

causes.en: PV string Voc higher than the inverter's max PV input voltage.
causes.ur: PV string ka Voc inverter ke max PV input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage higher than the inverter's max BAT input voltage.
causes.ur: Battery voltage inverter ke max BAT input voltage se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the PV string Voc is below the max PV input voltage on the label.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke PV string ka Voc label par likhe max PV input voltage se neeche hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is high, reduce the number of PV panels in series.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc zyada hai to series mein lage PV panels ki sankhya kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage and compare with the max battery input voltage; remove one pack if it is over.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage measure karke max battery input voltage se compare karein, agar zyada ho to aik pack nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Always switch the DC off before changing the string or battery configuration.
solutions.ur: String ya battery configuration badalne se pehle hamesha DC off karein.

source.title: GW ET Series | ET Plus Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.1, section 4.1 Error Messages

meaning.en: On ET the isolation monitor measures the PV string and the battery both, so either side's low ground insulation trips it.
meaning.ur: ET par isolation monitor PV string aur battery dono measure karta hai, is liye kisi bhi taraf ka kam ground insulation trip karwa deta hai.

causes.en: PV panels not grounded well or DC cable broken.
causes.ur: PV panels theek se grounded nahi ya DC cable tooti hui hai.

causes.en: PV panels aged or ambient humidity heavy.
causes.ur: PV panels purane ho chuke hain ya ambient humidity zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check earth to inverter frame resistance with a multimeter; it should be close to zero.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth se inverter frame ki resistance check karein, zero ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure each PV input to earth and the battery terminals to earth separately.
solutions.ur: Har PV input ko earth se aur battery terminals ko alag se earth se measure karein.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery first, then the PV strings, to identify which side is leaking.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery isolate karein, phir PV strings, taake pata chale kis taraf leak hai.

solutions.en: Re-terminate or replace the affected connector, then restart and confirm the reading.
solutions.ur: Matlab wala connector dobara lagayein ya replace karein, phir restart karke reading confirm karein.

source.title: GW ET Series | ET Plus Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.1, section 4.1 Error Messages

meaning.en: The relay self-test failed, which the manual ties to N and PE not being connected well on the AC side.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test fail hua, manual isay AC side par N aur PE ke theek na lagne se jodta hai.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not connected well on the AC side.
causes.ur: AC side par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.
Kabhi kabhi relay self-test fail hota hai.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check for voltage between N and PE on the AC side; normally below 10V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se AC side par N aur PE ke darmiyan voltage check karein, aam tor par 10V se kam.

solutions.en: If it reads above 10V, re-terminate N and PE and retest.
solutions.ur: Agar 10V se zyada ho to N aur PE dobara terminate karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Then restart the inverter and confirm the self-test passes.
solutions.ur: Phir inverter restart karke confirm karein ke self-test pass ho gaya.
